We now have a working loop where your agent plans the task, Fo MCP hands it to Fo, Fo carries it out in the physical world, and reports back once it’s done.

Fo is the agent that has arrived in the physical world, and people are going to build entire businesses on top of it.

I don’t want my best ideas to die in open tabs.

The place I want to visit. The thing I want to learn. The project I keep meaning to start.

So I built Pact: a Chrome extension that brings Claude and Fo MCP to the page you’re on.

Talk through the page with Anthropic's best models. Turn what you found into a plan. Review a proposed task for Fo to carry out through your connected tools.

Picture finding a coastal walk, planning Saturday around it, then reviewing a request to check your calendar and draft an invitation.

You see the exact request. You decide whether it goes ahead. Pact is build for ANYONE with 47 tabs.

That’s the idea behind Pact: make the distance between “that looks interesting” and “let’s do it” a little smaller.

Built for Wajo’s GSD Hackathon.

text:
Wow, Wajo just shipped Fo MCP, and this changes how I think about AI agents entirely

Most AI agents live on a screen. They can research, plan and write, but the moment a task needs a phone call, a booking or a purchase, you're back to doing it yourself

Fo MCP closes that gap completely

It plugs Fo into the agents you already use, your AI tools, your terminal, even hardware. Your agent does the thinking, Fo does the legwork

The terminal use case is what caught my attention. You ask Fo to call the plumber for a quote, and it places the real call and reports back. You never leave your workflow

We have been talking about "agentic AI" for two years. This launch is insane.

Every agent in the world can now do something in the real world, which means people can build entire businesses on agents that actually execute.

Fo is the agent that has finally arrived in the physical world.

Bu, sıradan bir yapay zeka ajanı değil. Gerçek dünyada işini senin yerine halleden bir ajan çıktı.

Ne istediğini söylüyorsun, gerisini o hallediyor. Senin yerine telefon görüşmesi yapıyor. Uçak biletini ve restoran rezervasyonunu ayarlıyor. Takviminde uygun saati bulup davetiyeyi gönderiyor. Tek bir fotoğraftan kıyafet alışverişi yapıyor. Sabahları da e-postanı, takvimini ve Slack'ini tek bir özette önüne koyuyor.

Girişimciler için bu büyük bir fırsat. Artık sadece konuşan değil, işi gerçekten yapan bir ajanın üzerine şirket kurabilirsin.

Hep konuştuğumuz o yapay zeka asistanı ekrandan çıktı ve fiziksel dünyaya adım attı. Hem de beklediğimizden çok daha erken.
